scope: Analytic source/doublet kernel gradients evaluated outside the boundary at quarter/half/three-quarter panel locations. This is independent of the boundary potential-derivative Cp routine. Relative offset means offset / local panel length; absolute means distance / chord. Neither maximum nor endpoint samples are excluded.

kernelVerification.reference: Exact circular-cylinder exterior velocity at radius1.4 and at the exact same near-panel sampling protocols

notClaimed: Finite-offset normal velocity and Cp differences from a SURFACE target are diagnostics, not strict surface residuals or experimental errors. Taking the observation distance to zero together with panel size may yield nonuniform convergence for constant densities; the independent cylinder control measures that. No surface-limit or experimental-validation claim is made.
